command: set -eu; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); echo '--- SHELL AUDIO PROBE ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'CLASSPATH=/data/local/tmp/aicallbridge-shell-probe.apk app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.ShellAudioProbe'; echo '--- END SHELL AUDIO PROBE ---'
